auth user admin {
    description "Admin User"
    encrypted-password $6$REDACTED
    partition Common
    partition-access {
        all-partitions {
            role admin
        }
    }
    shell tmsh
}
auth user auditor {
    description "Read only"
    encrypted-password $6$REDACTED
    partition Common
    partition-access {
        Common {
            role guest
        }
    }
    shell none
}
ltm pool /Common/pool_web {
    load-balancing-mode least-connections-member
    members {
        /Common/10.20.0.11:8443 {
            address 10.20.0.11
            session monitor-enabled
            state up
        }
        /Common/10.20.0.12:8443 {
            address 10.20.0.12
            session user-disabled
            state up
        }
    }
    monitor /Common/https
}
ltm pool /Common/pool_legacy {
    members {
        /Common/10.20.0.21:80 {
            address 10.20.0.21
            session monitor-enabled
            state up
        }
    }
    monitor /Common/http
}
ltm profile client-ssl /Common/clientssl-secure {
    app-service none
    cert /Common/site.crt
    ciphers ECDHE+AES-GCM
    defaults-from /Common/clientssl
    key /Common/site.key
    options { dont-insert-empty-fragments no-sslv3 no-tlsv1 no-tlsv1.1 }
}
ltm profile client-ssl /Common/clientssl-legacy {
    app-service none
    cert /Common/legacy.crt
    ciphers DEFAULT
    defaults-from /Common/clientssl
    key /Common/legacy.key
    options { dont-insert-empty-fragments no-sslv3 }
}
ltm virtual /Common/vs_web_https {
    destination /Common/203.0.113.10:443
    ip-protocol tcp
    mask 255.255.255.255
    pool /Common/pool_web
    profiles {
        /Common/clientssl-secure {
            context clientside
        }
        /Common/http { }
        /Common/tcp { }
    }
    source 0.0.0.0/0
    translate-address enabled
    translate-port enabled
}
ltm virtual /Common/vs_legacy_https {
    destination /Common/203.0.113.20:443
    ip-protocol tcp
    mask 255.255.255.255
    pool /Common/pool_legacy
    profiles {
        /Common/clientssl-legacy {
            context clientside
        }
        /Common/http { }
    }
    source 0.0.0.0/0
}
ltm virtual /Common/vs_retired {
    destination /Common/203.0.113.30:80
    disabled
    ip-protocol tcp
    pool /Common/pool_legacy
    profiles {
        /Common/http { }
    }
    source 0.0.0.0/0
}
net route /Common/default {
    gw 203.0.113.1
    network default
}
net route /Common/internal {
    gw 10.20.0.1
    network 10.0.0.0/8
}
net self /Common/self-external {
    address 203.0.113.2/24
    allow-service none
    traffic-group /Common/traffic-group-local-only
    vlan external
}
net self /Common/self-internal {
    address 10.20.0.2/24
    allow-service default
    traffic-group /Common/traffic-group-local-only
    vlan internal
}
sys global-settings {
    console-inactivity-timeout 900
    gui-setup disabled
    hostname bigip-edge-01.corp.example.net
    mgmt-dhcp disabled
}
sys httpd {
    auth-pam-idle-timeout 1200
    ssl-ciphersuite ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
    ssl-port 443
}
sys ntp {
    servers { 10.10.0.10 10.10.0.11 }
    timezone UTC
}
sys snmp {
    agent-addresses { tcp6:161 udp6:161 }
    communities {
        /Common/comm-public {
            community-name public
            source default
        }
        /Common/comm-ops {
            access rw
            community-name Str0ngRW
            source 10.10.0.0/24
        }
    }
}
sys sshd {
    banner enabled
    banner-text "Authorised access only."
    inactivity-timeout 900
}
sys syslog {
    remote-servers {
        /Common/syslog1 {
            host 10.10.0.20
            remote-port 514
        }
        /Common/syslog2 {
            host 10.10.0.21
            remote-port 514
        }
    }
}
